rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_HTTP {
    meta:
        description = "Detects HTTP traffic patterns typical of Cobalt Strike beacons"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        tlp = "amber"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike"
    strings:
        $http_get = /GET \/[a-z]{4} HTTP\/1\.1/ ascii
        $http_post = /POST \/[a-z]{4} HTTP\/1\.1/ ascii
        $header_host = "Host:" ascii
        $header_useragent = "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0" ascii
    condition:
        $http_get or ($http_post and $header_host and $header_useragent)
}

arguments.summary: Anomalous authentication chain initiated from IP 10.0.5.14 was traced to a compromised host WS-FIN-042 used by user CORP\jsmith in the Finance department. The host exhibited Cobalt Strike beaconing behavior to an external C2 server (198.51.100.23) over HTTPS, followed by lateral movement attempts via SMB and Kerberos. The svc_etl_prod service account was misused as part of the attack chain, leading to its revocation. UEBA initially scored the activity as low risk due to timing within business hours, but IDS and SIEM correlation confirmed malicious intent. Containment actions were partially successful: IAM controls successfully revoked service account tokens, but firewall and endpoint isolation requests were denied without justification.
